changelog:
Initial release of codemap.

- Build a local SQLite index of all functions, classes, methods, interfaces, and types in your code repositories for fast symbol lookup.
- Supports Python (functions, classes, methods) and JS/TS/JSX/TSX (function declarations, exported arrow consts, classes, interfaces, type aliases).
- CLI tool enables building, querying, and outlining indexed code symbols with a single command.
- Pure Python implementation with no network, model calls, or external dependencies required.
- Skips common directories like node_modules, .git, and dist during indexing.
- Designed to reduce redundant file scans and token usage for agents working across large projects.
